name: layout-app-shell
summary: The authenticated app frame — NavBar (left rail, 50px, --nav-panel-bg) + Header (top, 55px) + the one scrolling content panel + a shell-level overlay layer (toasts, OmniBox, portals). The default shell for every in-app page. Toggle the chrome to see how the other shells (EmptyLayout, LoginLayout) drop regions.
decisionFlow: Start EVERY authenticated product screen here — the app shell is the outermost frame (top nav bar + left icon rail + content region). It is not optional chrome; it's the frame the page mounts into.
Full-bleed page WITHOUT the shell (login, error, print, embedded/public view)? -> use a bare layout (LoginLayout/EmptyLayout/PublicLayout), NOT the app shell.
Need a settings-style secondary side menu inside the content? -> compose layout-screen-regions (a left settings panel), don't fork the shell.
The shell is fixed: don't recreate the top bar / icon rail per page — mount your screen into its content region.

empty.note: swap the page body for an empty-state prompt

anatomy.note: render the annotated region-callout diagram instead of the interactive shell

regions: NavBar — left rail, @nav-icon-width 50px, --nav-panel-bg; the module icons (active = --primary pill)
Header — top, @header-height 55px; brand logo · global search · notifications · user menu
Content panel — MLayoutContent in FlotoScrollView; the routed page slot, the only scrolling region
Overlay layer — OmniBox, notifications, PortalTargets; shell-level, above the content
do: Use the Layout shell for every authenticated app page (the default — no route override needed).
Keep the content panel the only scrolling region.
Mount global/portal UI (toasts, OmniBox) at the overlay layer, above the content.
dont: Don't put the breadcrumb/back in the Header — that lives in the page header.
Don't add a second scrolling container inside the content panel.

a11y.summary: Structural reference, not interactive. In the product the regions map to landmarks — NavBar = <nav>, Header = <header>, content = <main>; the content panel is the only scroll container, so focus order is nav → header → content.
issues: The overlay layer (toasts/OmniBox) must manage focus + ESC at the product level.

knownIssues: Documentation diagram, not the live shell — the product Layout (src/views/layouts/main.vue) is the source of truth.

[element] The obs-layout-* WEB COMPONENT is a fixed visual demo, not a slotted layout primitive — you can't put a real page inside it. Use the layout GUIDANCE (decisionFlow/regions) + compose the shell from atoms + the 12-col grid + tokens.
changelog: 2026-06-29: added to the Elements site (Foundations › Layout) — Anatomy diagram + interactive chrome toggles; render-first from the Storybook story.
2026-06-29: playground + examples widths fixed to fill the stage.
whenToUse: Every signed-in page renders into this frame — you don't opt in. Switch to another shell only for login, print/export, or system pages.
usedIn: Every authenticated in-app page — the default for ~all routes.
Drop the chrome via a different shell: login, report export, upgrade/restore.
